note: Revise this table without touching code. Set MDGUARD_MARKERS to point at a replacement file. Each entry needs a rationale; an entry without one is not a marker, it is a preference.

markers.name: delve
markers.rationale: Near-absent from the corpus and one of the most over-represented verbs in model prose.

markers.name: discourse_connector
markers.rationale: Sentence-initial connectors the model adds to pad transitions between claims that already follow each other.

markers.name: buzzword_adjective
markers.rationale: Adjectives that assert quality instead of describing behavior. Named in the house plain-copy rules.

markers.name: leverage_utilize
markers.rationale: Latinate substitutes for use, chosen for register rather than meaning.

markers.name: hedged_authority
markers.pattern: \bit(?:'s| is) (?:worth noting|important to note)\b|\bit should be noted\b
markers.rationale: A whole clause that carries no information; the note follows regardless.

markers.name: landscape_realm
markers.rationale: Scene-setting nouns that open a paragraph without adding a fact.

markers.name: not_only_but_also
markers.rationale: A balanced construction the model reaches for to make one claim sound like two.

markers.name: promotional_verb
markers.rationale: Marketing verbs applied to documentation, where the reader has already bought in.

markers.name: dive_into
markers.rationale: Tour-guide framing that addresses the reader instead of stating the subject.

markers.name: testament_to
markers.rationale: Evaluative filler; the evidence it introduces stands on its own.

markers.name: comprehensive_crucial
markers.rationale: Intensifiers used as a substitute for a measured claim.

markers.name: in_conclusion
markers.rationale: Essay scaffolding. A summary in a technical document is a heading, not a phrase.

markers.name: ensure_that
markers.rationale: Padding around an imperative that reads better as the imperative.

markers.name: when_it_comes_to
markers.pattern: \bwhen it comes to\b|\bin terms of\b|\bat the end of the day\b
markers.rationale: Topic-shifting phrases that can be deleted without changing the sentence.

markers.name: game_changer
markers.rationale: Superlatives about the artifact rather than statements about what it does.
